rationale: Sylvester is a security-focused student exploring cybersecurity and digital privacy, while Anshu is a founder and CISO building AI security frameworks and tools at the intersection of agent safety and LLM security. intro_message: Sylvester Reagan, meet Anshu Gupta — Anshu is a CISO and founder building security frameworks for AI agents and LLMs, and would be a great person to learn from if you want to explore how cybersecurity intersects with AI safety.
